ui.Estado del equipo, recomendación y selec: PC status, recommendation and profile selection.
ui.Por qué va lento el equipo: procesos, me: Why the PC is slow: processes, memory, CPU, disk, updates and Windows 11. It only measures; nothing is changed.
ui.Cómo cambia el equipo con el tiempo: tie: How the PC changes over time: boot time, programs that get added and what each installer adds.
ui.Qué programas han usado la cámara, el mi: Which programs used the camera, microphone and location, and when. To remove a permission, the matching Windows Settings page opens.
ui.Qué ocupa el disco y qué programas tiene: What fills the disk and which programs are installed. SafeBoost only shows it: you decide what to delete or uninstall.
ui.Apps preinstaladas, telemetría, publicid: Preinstalled apps, telemetry, ads and suggestions. Removed apps are restored by reinstalling them from the Microsoft Store (needs internet).
ui.Los servicios pasan a Manual, no a Desha: Services are set to Manual, not Disabled: they still start when an app or trigger needs them. Defender, Windows Update, the Store and networking are never touched.
ui.Acciones irreversibles: los archivos bor: Irreversible actions: deleted files cannot be recovered and need a separate confirmation. Minimum ages and files in use are respected.
ui.Efectos visuales, energía, red, juegos,: Visual effects, power, network, gaming, search, memory and security. 'Manual only' options are never enabled by a profile.
ui.Cada sesión guarda el estado previo de l: Each session stores the previous state of what it changed. 'Undo' restores it in reverse order. To roll back the whole system, use 'System Restore'.
ui.Se desactivan igual que en el Administra: Disabled the same way as in Task Manager (nothing is deleted). Impact is an estimate: Windows does not expose Task Manager's value through an API.
ui.Detectando entorno (versión, edición, di: Detecting environment (version, edition, disk, domain, printers)…
ui.La RAM está al {pct} %. Windows usa el d: RAM is at {pct}%. Windows is using the disk as memory and stutters.
ui.{detail}. Actívalo en Seguridad de Windo: {detail}. Turn it on in Windows Security: a PC without this protection can also be slow because of malware.
ui.Windows tiene actualizaciones a medio in: Windows has half-installed updates. Restart before optimizing or measuring performance.
ui.La última actualización se instaló hace: The last update was installed {days} days ago. Run Windows Update until it says “You're up to date”.
ui.La CPU está al {pct} % repartida entre m: The CPU is at {pct}%, spread across many processes.
ui.{name} ({kind}) retrasa el arranque unos: {name} ({kind}) delays startup by about {secs} s{times}. {advice} See the full list below.
ui.{cpu} tiene {threads} hilos: con varias: {cpu} has {threads} threads: with several things open at once it falls short. Settings cannot fix this.
ui.Cambiar el disco del sistema por un SSD: Replacing the system drive with an SSD is the most noticeable upgrade on a PC with a hard drive: startup and app launches several times faster.
ui.Quedan {free} libres ({pct} %). Windows: {free} free ({pct}%). Windows needs space to update and for virtual memory: use Cleanup.
ui.No cumple los requisitos de Windows 11: It does not meet the Windows 11 requirements

ui.Windows 10 dejó de recibir parches gratu: Windows 10 stopped getting free patches on {date}. {verdict}.
ui.Memoria, procesador y disco tienen marge: Memory, processor and disk have headroom. If it feels slow at a specific moment, analyze again right then.
ui.El equipo tiene {ram}. Windows y un nave: The PC has {ram}. Windows and a browser already fill it, and then it uses the disk as memory. No SafeBoost profile replaces adding memory.
ui.Ampliar a 8 GB es la mejora que más se n: Upgrading to 8 GB is the most noticeable improvement.
ui.Tiene {n} ranura(s) libre(s): añadir un: It has {n} free slot(s): adding a 4 or 8 GB module is the most noticeable improvement.

ui.{disk} ha consumido el {wear} % de su vi: {disk} has used {wear}% of its estimated lifespan. It still works, but keep a backup.

bloatware.candy_crush.description: Uninstalls Candy Crush Saga and Soda Saga for all users and stops it from being reinstalled for new accounts.
bloatware.candy_crush.rationale: Both the installed AppX package and the provisioned package in the image are removed; if only the installed one is removed, Windows deploys it again for every new profile.
bloatware.candy_crush.revert_note: Undone by reinstalling it from the Microsoft Store with winget: needs an internet connection. No verified Store ID: it is searched by name.

bloatware.news_interests.description: Hides the widgets panel (Windows 11) and 'News and interests' on the taskbar (Windows 10).
bloatware.news_interests.rationale: The policy is used instead of the TaskbarDa user value because on Windows 11 24H2 the UCPD driver blocks third-party processes from writing TaskbarDa.

bloatware.copilot_policy.description: Hides the Copilot button on Windows 11 builds older than 24H2.
bloatware.copilot_policy.rationale: On 24H2+ Copilot is a regular app (removed with bloatware.copilot); this policy only works on 23H2 and earlier.

privacy.diagtrack.description: Stops and disables 'Connected User Experiences and Telemetry'.
privacy.diagtrack.rationale: Here Disabled is used instead of Manual: DiagTrack has triggers that start it again if left on Manual, which would undo the change.

privacy.dmwappush.description: Disables the WAP push message routing service used for telemetry.
privacy.dmwappush.rationale: MDM/Intune enrollment also uses it, so it is skipped on managed PCs.

privacy.telemetry_policy_required.description: Limits diagnostic data to the 'Required' level.
privacy.telemetry_policy_required.rationale: On Home and Pro the value 0 (Security) is not honored and is treated as 1; 1 is written so the detected state is real.

privacy.telemetry_policy_security.description: Turns off telemetry except the minimum security data.
privacy.telemetry_policy_security.rationale: Level 0 is only honored by the Enterprise, Education and IoT editions.

privacy.advertising_id.description: Stops apps from using an advertising ID to show personalized ads.
privacy.advertising_id.rationale: Both the user value and the machine policy are written so it cannot be turned back on from Settings.

privacy.tailored_experiences.description: Stops Microsoft from using diagnostic data to offer personalized tips and ads.
privacy.tailored_experiences.rationale: User value equivalent to the switch in Settings > Privacy > Diagnostics.

privacy.suggestions_start.description: Turns off suggested apps and promotional recommendations in Start.
privacy.suggestions_start.rationale: SubscribedContent-338388 controls Start suggestions; Start_IrisRecommendations controls Windows 11 recommendations.

privacy.suggestions_settings.description: Turns off suggested content in Settings and 'tips and tricks' notifications.
privacy.suggestions_settings.rationale: ContentDeliveryManager keys that feed the promotional banners in Settings.

privacy.suggestions_lockscreen.description: Turns off promotional text over the lock screen.
privacy.suggestions_lockscreen.rationale: It does not turn off Windows Spotlight as a background, only the 'fun facts and tips' layer.

privacy.silent_app_install.description: Stops Windows from reinstalling Candy Crush and similar apps on its own.
privacy.silent_app_install.rationale: Without this change, ContentDeliveryManager reinstalls sponsored apps after feature updates.

privacy.feedback_frequency.rationale: NumberOfSIUFInPeriod=0 equals 'Never' in Settings > Privacy > Diagnostics.

privacy.task_compat_appraiser.description: Disables the Compatibility Appraiser scheduled tasks.
privacy.task_compat_appraiser.rationale: It collects an app inventory for telemetry. Note: Windows Update also uses it to check whether the PC can get a feature update; with it off, the offer of a new version may be delayed. Tasks that do not exist in the current build are skipped.

privacy.task_ceip.description: Disables the Customer Experience Improvement Program (CEIP) scheduled tasks.
privacy.task_ceip.rationale: Tasks that package and send CEIP data; they do not affect how the system works. Tasks that do not exist in the current build are skipped.

privacy.task_disk_diag.description: Disables the Disk Diagnostic Data Collector scheduled tasks.
privacy.task_disk_diag.rationale: Sends disk diagnostic data to Microsoft; local SMART alerts keep working. Tasks that do not exist in the current build are skipped.

services.fax.description: Sets the Fax service startup to Manual.
services.fax.rationale: Manual, not Disabled: the service is still available if an app asks for it or a trigger needs it, so no feature ever breaks. Only used with fax modems.

services.mapsbroker.description: Sets the MapsBroker service startup to Manual.
services.mapsbroker.rationale: Manual, not Disabled: the service is still available if an app asks for it or a trigger needs it, so no feature ever breaks. Only needed for offline maps; on Manual it starts when the Maps app asks for it.

services.retaildemo.description: Sets the RetailDemo service startup to Manual.
services.retaildemo.rationale: Manual, not Disabled: the service is still available if an app asks for it or a trigger needs it, so no feature ever breaks. Only used on store display PCs.

services.wersvc.description: Sets the WerSvc service startup to Manual.
services.wersvc.rationale: Manual, not Disabled: the service is still available if an app asks for it or a trigger needs it, so no feature ever breaks. On Manual it still starts by trigger when an app crashes, so local crash dumps are kept.

services.sysmain.description: Sets the SysMain service startup to Manual.
services.sysmain.rationale: Manual, not Disabled: the service is still available if an app asks for it or a trigger needs it, so no feature ever breaks. On an SSD the benefit of preloading is minimal and it causes writes; on an HDD it is kept because it does speed up app launches.

services.hp_analytics.description: Sets the analytics service HP installs on its laptops to Manual.
services.hp_analytics.rationale: It sends PC usage data to HP and uses resources at startup. It plays no part in drivers, function keys or updates. Only shown if the service exists.

services.nvidia_telemetry.description: Sets the NVIDIA driver telemetry service (older versions) to Manual.
services.nvidia_telemetry.rationale: It collects and sends usage data to NVIDIA. The driver and the NVIDIA control panel work the same. Only shown if the service exists.

services.adobe_genuine.description: Sets the Adobe service that checks licenses in the background to Manual.
services.adobe_genuine.rationale: It starts with Windows even if you do not use Adobe programs. Adobe programs keep working. Only shown if the service exists.

services.adobe_updater.description: Sets the Adobe Acrobat/Reader updater to Manual.
services.adobe_updater.rationale: Acrobat still checks for updates when you open it, but there is no longer a resident service from startup. Optional because Acrobat updates fix security issues. Only shown if the service exists.

visual.best_performance.description: Turns off animations, shadows and transparency, but keeps ClearType and thumbnails.
visual.best_performance.rationale: VisualFXSetting=3 (custom) + the 'best performance' UserPreferencesMask; smoothing is controlled separately with FontSmoothing. After writing, WM_SETTINGCHANGE is sent to apply it without signing out.

cleanup.temp_user.description: Deletes the interactive user's %TEMP% (files older than 24 h).
cleanup.temp_user.rationale: A minimum age is respected so installers or open apps using their temporary files do not break.
cleanup.temp_user.revert_note: Irreversible action: deleted files cannot be recovered. Needs a separate confirmation.

cleanup.temp_windows.rationale: Same age rule; locked files are skipped without error.
cleanup.temp_windows.revert_note: Irreversible action: deleted files cannot be recovered. Needs a separate confirmation.

cleanup.wu_cache.description: Deletes packages already downloaded to SoftwareDistribution\Download that are older than 10 days.
cleanup.wu_cache.rationale: The wuauserv service is not stopped (it is on the protected list): only old, unlocked files are deleted.
cleanup.wu_cache.revert_note: Irreversible action: deleted files cannot be recovered. Needs a separate confirmation.

cleanup.prefetch_orphans.description: Deletes Prefetch entries not used for more than 90 days (usually from uninstalled programs).
cleanup.prefetch_orphans.rationale: Emptying Prefetch entirely makes startup slower; only stale .pf files are removed. Windows recreates them if the program runs again.
cleanup.prefetch_orphans.revert_note: Irreversible action: deleted files cannot be recovered. Needs a separate confirmation.

cleanup.recycle_bin.description: Empties the Recycle Bin on all drives.
cleanup.recycle_bin.revert_note: Irreversible action: deleted files cannot be recovered. Needs a separate confirmation.

cleanup.thumbnails.description: Deletes thumbcache_*.db; Windows recreates thumbnails as you browse.
cleanup.thumbnails.rationale: Files in use by File Explorer are skipped.
cleanup.thumbnails.revert_note: Irreversible action: deleted files cannot be recovered. Needs a separate confirmation.

cleanup.browser_cache.description: Deletes the cache of Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Firefox. Cookies, history, passwords and open tabs are not touched.
cleanup.browser_cache.rationale: The cache rebuilds itself; deleting it frees space (often several GB) and the first pages will load a little slower. Open browsers are skipped because they use those files.
cleanup.browser_cache.revert_note: Irreversible but harmless: the browser downloads again whatever it needs.

cleanup.windows_old.description: Deletes the Windows.old folder left by a major Windows update (usually 10-30 GB) using Windows Disk Cleanup.
cleanup.windows_old.rationale: Windows keeps it for 10 days so you can go back to the previous version. After that, or if everything works fine, it only takes up space. The official tool is used because the folder is protected by TrustedInstaller.
cleanup.windows_old.revert_note: Irreversible action: afterwards you can no longer go back to the previous version of Windows. Needs a separate confirmation.

power.hibernate_off.description: Removes hiberfil.sys and frees as much space as ~40% of the RAM.
power.hibernate_off.rationale: Optional and outside the profiles: it also turns off Fast Startup (which changes the boot measurement) and, on laptops, removes the protection against a drained battery.

power.high_performance.description: Activates the 'High performance' power plan (creating it if missing).
power.high_performance.rationale: On laptops it shortens battery life, so it is only preselected on desktops. On PCs with Modern Standby (S0) the plan may not exist; it is created by duplicating the base scheme.

power.ultimate_performance.description: Creates and activates the hidden 'Ultimate performance' plan.
power.ultimate_performance.rationale: Removes power-management micro-latency; noticeably higher power use. Mutually exclusive with High performance.

power.dc_battery_saver.description: Turns on Windows battery saver below 50% (20% by default). Nothing changes when plugged in.
power.dc_battery_saver.rationale: Battery saver limits background activity and lowers brightness; turning it on earlier extends battery life without touching plugged-in performance.

power.dc_cpu_max.description: Caps the processor's maximum speed at 80% only when the laptop runs on battery.
power.dc_cpu_max.rationale: The last MHz use the most power and heat. Plugged in it stays at 100%. If the PC feels slow on battery, undo it.

power.dc_display_off.description: Turns the screen off after 3 minutes idle when the laptop runs on battery.
power.dc_display_off.rationale: The screen is the biggest power draw on a laptop. Plugged in, your configured timeout is kept.

network.nagle_off.description: Sends small TCP packets immediately (lower latency in games and interactive apps).
network.nagle_off.rationale: TcpAckFrequency=1 and TCPNoDelay=1 are written on every interface with an IP. Real gain only in apps that do not disable Nagle themselves; cost: more packets on the network.

network.autotuning_normal.description: Checks and restores the TCP receive window to the recommended level.
network.autotuning_normal.rationale: Turning autotuning off (common advice) hurts performance on fast connections; the right thing is to make sure it is not 'disabled' or 'highlyrestricted'.

network.dns.description: Sets public DNS servers (Cloudflare, Quad9 or Google) on active adapters.
network.dns.rationale: Never automatic: on domain PCs it breaks Active Directory name resolution. The user chooses the provider.

performance.edge_startup_boost.description: Stops Microsoft Edge from loading into memory at Windows startup to open faster.
performance.edge_startup_boost.rationale: Startup boost keeps Edge processes resident from startup even if you do not use it. On PCs with little RAM that memory is better spent on what you are using. Only preselected with less than 5 GB of RAM. Edge and Chrome will show "Your browser is managed by your organization": they say so for any policy, and it does not mean anyone controls the PC.

performance.edge_background.description: Really closes Edge when you close the window instead of leaving it in the background.
performance.edge_background.rationale: With "Continue running background extensions and apps", Edge keeps using memory and CPU after you close it. Only preselected with less than 5 GB of RAM. Edge and Chrome will show "Your browser is managed by your organization": they say so for any policy, and it does not mean anyone controls the PC.

performance.chrome_background.description: Really closes Google Chrome when you close the window instead of leaving it in the background.
performance.chrome_background.rationale: Chrome can stay resident with background extensions and apps. Only shown if Chrome is installed, and preselected with less than 5 GB of RAM. Edge and Chrome will show "Your browser is managed by your organization": they say so for any policy, and it does not mean anyone controls the PC.

performance.foreground_priority.description: Gives longer quantums to the active window.
performance.foreground_priority.rationale: Win32PrioritySeparation=0x26 (38): short, variable quantum with maximum foreground boost.

gaming.gamedvr_off.description: Turns off background recording and the Game Bar overlay.
gaming.gamedvr_off.rationale: Background capture uses GPU and disk even when unused. Xbox identity components are not removed.

gaming.hags.description: Turns on HAGS if the GPU and driver support it.
gaming.hags.rationale: Requires WDDM 2.7+ and a compatible GPU; checked beforehand. It can cause instability with old drivers.

search.indexing_drives.description: Removes the content indexing attribute on the drives you choose.
search.indexing_drives.rationale: The WSearch service is not turned off: that would break Start and Outlook search. By default it only suggests data drives, not the system drive.

services.pcasvc.description: Sets the PcaSvc service startup to Manual.
services.pcasvc.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. It only shows compatibility notices after installing old software.

services.trkwks.description: Sets the TrkWks service startup to Manual.
services.trkwks.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. Keeps shortcuts to files moved between NTFS volumes on a network working.

services.wisvc.description: Sets the wisvc service startup to Manual.
services.wisvc.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. Only needed if the PC is in the Insider program.

services.phonesvc.description: Sets the PhoneSvc service startup to Manual.
services.phonesvc.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. Telephony and SMS on PCs with a modem.

services.wmpnetworksvc.description: Sets the WMPNetworkSvc service startup to Manual.
services.wmpnetworksvc.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. Sharing a media library over DLNA.

services.xblauthmanager.description: Sets the XblAuthManager service startup to Manual.
services.xblauthmanager.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. Starts on demand when opening an Xbox game.

services.xblgamesave.description: Sets the XblGameSave service startup to Manual.
services.xblgamesave.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. Starts on demand when syncing saved games.

services.xboxnetapisvc.description: Sets the XboxNetApiSvc service startup to Manual.
services.xboxnetapisvc.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. Starts on demand in online Xbox games.

services.lfsvc.description: Sets the lfsvc service startup to Manual.
services.lfsvc.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. On desktops location rarely helps; on laptops it is kept.

services.spooler.description: Sets the Spooler service startup to Manual.
services.spooler.rationale: Manual, not Disabled, so it starts on demand if something needs it. Only when no printers are installed; with printers it is on the protected list.

privacy.background_apps.description: Stops Store apps from running in the background.
privacy.background_apps.rationale: GlobalUserDisabled works on Windows 10; on Windows 11 the LetAppsRunInBackground=2 policy (force deny) is used. Side effect: notifications from Store apps (e.g. Mail) may arrive late.

memory.pagefile_system_managed.description: If virtual memory is off or fixed-size, sets it back to 'system managed'.
memory.pagefile_system_managed.rationale: A fixed or missing pagefile causes out-of-memory errors and lost crash dumps.

memory.pagefile_fixed.description: Fixes the pagefile size on the system drive (minimum = maximum).
memory.pagefile_fixed.rationale: Only for users who need it (e.g. avoiding fragmentation on an HDD). A low value causes out-of-memory closes and can prevent full crash dumps.

security.cpu_mitigations_off.description: Turns off speculative execution vulnerability mitigations to regain performance.
security.cpu_mitigations_off.rationale: SECURITY WARNING: it exposes the PC to side-channel attacks (reading memory of other processes, including the browser). It only makes sense on isolated or test machines. Needs double confirmation and is never part of an automatic profile.
